message: Hi Alex, it's Chloe at Rapid Plumbing, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Chloe, thanks for replying! No, I can't promise a specific number of customers — anyone who guarantees that isn't being straight with you. What I can do: fix the real issues on your site (speed, mobile, broken forms, etc.) with the $900 fix pack, which removes barriers stopping people from calling you.
